_doc: Mapping last skill → recommended next step for hermes. Used by hooks/pipeline-next-step/handler.py. Keys are skill names without leading slash. Adjusted from gstack original to reference only skills that exist in hermes (yc-review → requesting-code-review; removed Claude-Code-only steps like verify, vercel:deploy).

yc-office-hours.why: check scope in 4 modes (Expansion / Selective / Hold / Reduction)

yc-ceo-review.why: draft formal task plan (hermes-native superpowers-adapted skill)

writing-plans.why: arch-review the plan: diagrams, edge cases, test plan

yc-eng-review.why: OWASP + STRIDE if there is user input / auth / payments / PII

yc-design-review.why: fold UX edits back into the task plan

yc-devex-review.why: fold DX improvements into the task plan

executing-plans.why: pre-commit verification + security scan (hermes-native, replaces gstack /yc-review)
